title: 第八章 柯南如何饲养
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

毛利兰好不容易克服了羞涩，点头同意了搬到工藤宅和新一同居。没想到作为借口的柯南第一个跳出来反对，而且声音特别大。

“为什么啊，难道柯南讨厌我吗？”毛利兰双手叉腰，眼睛瞪的大大的。

难道这小子刚刚吵着要住在这里，不是因为毛利家房子小，而是嫌我烦人吗？

渚琰·工藤新一也是趁热打铁（拱火）：“小兰，我建议把这小鬼撵回去让你爸爸照顾，你一个人搬来住！”

你是不是忘了我搬来的理由就是照顾柯南？小兰白眼一翻，懒得搭理这个被打坏了脑袋的推理笨蛋，只是气冲冲的看着柯南：“柯南，你为什么不同意啊？”

柯南当然不能同意啊，在他看来工藤新一肯定是黑衣人的同伙，简直不要太危险了，怎么能看着小兰搬进来呢？

可要是小兰问他理由……该、该说什么好呢？

“因、因为……小兰姐姐又没有和新一哥哥结婚，怎么能住在别人家呢！”

这个理由说出来，小兰当即变成了豆豆眼。

柯南也是心一横，干脆从小兰容易害羞的性格入手，铁了心要把小兰打成埋头鸵鸟、缩头乌龟：“呐呐！小兰姐姐和新一哥哥到底是什么关系？为什么可以住在新一哥哥家呢？”

“这个……”毛利兰的脸红在这几分钟就没褪下去过，一边闪躲着柯南的目光，一边恨恨瞪了一眼工藤新一：连柯南一个小孩子都知道的道理，你是怎么完全没往那方面想的？

而工藤新一似乎接受到了那目光中蕴含的信息，这时也站出来呵斥柯南：“笨蛋，我刚刚不是说了吗？小兰从今天起就是我的义母大人了！儿子和妈妈住在一起有什么奇怪的！”

毛利兰：……

柯南：……

系统：【……】

小兰几次举起了拳头，只是看到工藤新一头上的绷带后，还是不忍心打下去。

工藤新一又突然正色道：“小兰，其实我希望你搬过来一起住，和这个小鬼的事没有关系。”

小兰又慌了了：这家伙什么意思？只是单纯的想和自己的同居？纯纯的非分之想是吧？

慌乱之中，小兰随手拿起沙发上的靠枕抱在手里，双手用力将靠枕捏扁了，好像工藤新一再飙车什么虎狼之词就会直接丢出去。

“还记得我刚刚说过吧，那些黑衣人把我打晕后，把我的衣服和随身物品都拿走了，包括我的相机。”工藤新一却一本正经的解释起来了：“后来我和目暮警官回到现场，在那里发现了相机的外壳的碎片，但是没有底片，因为我当时在偷拍他们的交易现场。”

柯南的心里突然一沉。

毛利兰的神态也恢复正常，点了点头。她昨天和工藤新一游玩时拍了很多照片，可现在底片丢了，许多回忆都可惜了。

“而那张底片里可不止是我偷拍他们违法交易的照片，还有我们之前一起拍下的合照。”工藤新一提醒道：“我担心，如果那两人冲洗了我的底片，或许会注意到照片中的你。”

不是可能，分别是已经注意到了啊。

柯南的脸色苍白。他突然明白了过来，应该是黑衣人现在无法确认工藤新一究竟是生是死，又在底片里发现了小兰，认定了小兰与工藤新一关系紧密。于是黑衣人决定盯紧小兰，他们认为如果工藤新一还活着，一定会联系小兰的。

柯南看向渚琰·工藤新一，他认知中的黑衣人同伙：所以这家伙会一直纠缠着小兰不放，而自己继续阻止下去也会被怀疑的。

而工藤新一目光坚定，认真对小兰说道：“老实说，我没法夸口说我一定能保护小兰不受伤害，但我一定会尽力去做的，不仅因为这件事因我而起，更因为是小兰的安全遭到了威胁。如果这段时间能随时随地的确认小兰的安全，我会更安心一些。”

Page (1/3)

Mao Lilan finally overcame her shyness and nodded in agreement to move to Kudo's house and live with Xinyi.Unexpectedly, Conan, who was used as an excuse, was the first to object, and his voice was particularly loud.

"Why, does Conan hate me?" Mao Lilan put her hands on her hips and her eyes widened.

Could it be that this kid just clamored to live here not because the Maori house was small, but because he thought I was annoying?

Nagisa Yan and Kudo Shinichi also struck while the iron was hot (Gong Huo): "Xiaolan, I suggest you send this kid back and let your father take care of it, and you move in alone!"

Have you forgotten that the reason I moved here is to take care of Conan?Xiaolan rolled her eyes and was too lazy to pay attention to this idiot who had his brain broken. She just looked at Conan angrily: "Conan, why don't you agree?"

Of course Conan couldn't agree. In his opinion, Kudo Shinichi must be an accomplice of the man in black. It's not too dangerous. How could he watch Xiaolan move in?

But if Xiaolan asked him the reason... what should he say?

"Because...sister Xiaolan is not married to brother Shinichi, so how can she live in someone else's house!"

When this reason was stated, Xiaolan immediately turned into beet-eyed.

Conan was also determined. He simply started with Xiaolan's shy personality and was determined to beat Xiaolan into a ostrich with her head buried in the air. "Hey! What is the relationship between sister Xiaolan and brother Xinyi? Why can they live in brother Xinyi's house?"

"This..." Mao Lilan's blush has not faded in these few minutes. While avoiding Conan's gaze, she glared at Kudo Shinichi angrily: Even Conan, a child, knows this. How come you didn't think about it at all?

Kudo Shinichi seemed to have received the message in his eyes, and he stood up and scolded Conan: "Idiot, didn't I just say that? Xiaolan is my adoptive mother from today on! What's weird about my son living with his mother!"

Mao Lilan:......

Conan: ...

System: [……]

Xiaolan raised her fist several times, but after seeing the bandage on Kudo's new head, she still couldn't bear to punch him.

Kudo Shinichi suddenly said seriously again: "Xiaolan, actually I hope you move in together. It has nothing to do with this brat."

Xiaolan panicked again: What does this guy mean?Do you simply want to live with your partner?Just pure random thoughts, right?

In a panic, Xiaolan picked up the pillow on the sofa and hugged it in her hands. She squeezed the pillow flat with both hands, as if Kudo Shinichi would just throw it out if he kept racing.

"Remember what I just said, after those men in black knocked me unconscious, they took away my clothes and belongings, including my camera." Kudo Shinichi explained seriously: "Later, Officer Megure and I returned to the scene, where we found fragments of the camera's casing, but there were no negatives, because I was secretly filming their transaction scene."

Conan's heart suddenly sank.

Mao Lilan's expression returned to normal and nodded.She took a lot of photos when she and Kudo Shinichi were playing yesterday, but now that the negatives are lost, many memories are lost.

"And that negative contains not only the photos I secretly took of their illegal transactions, but also the photos we took together before." Kudo Shinichi reminded: "I'm worried that if those two people develop my negatives, they may notice you in the photo."

It's not possible, I've already noticed it.

Conan's face turned pale.He suddenly understood that it must be that the man in black was currently unable to confirm whether Kudo Shinichi was alive or dead. He also discovered Xiaolan in the film and determined that Xiaolan and Kudo Shinichi were closely related.So the men in black decided to keep an eye on Xiaolan. They believed that if Kudo Shinichi was still alive, he would definitely contact Xiaolan.

Conan looked at Nagisa Kudo Shinichi, the accomplice he recognized as the man in black: So this guy will keep pestering Xiaolan, and he will be suspected if he continues to stop him.

Kudo Shinichi's eyes were firm and he said seriously to Xiaolan: "Honestly, I can't boast that I can definitely protect Xiaolan from harm, but I will definitely try my best to do it, not only because this incident happened because of me, but also because Xiaolan's safety is threatened. If Xiaolan's safety can be confirmed anytime and anywhere during this period, I will feel more at ease."
